items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I went to see Mr. Louis Armstrong playing with Erskine Tate at the Vendome Theatre

ctx.x: Charlie Charleston played with a band out of Jackson, Tennessee, and he was born originally in St. Louis and I thought that he was the man and Johnny Dunn, but Mr. Wilson told me this is no, Louis Armstrong. I said, who is Louis Armstrong? So I had a distant cousin that took me back in Chicago and I went to see Mr. Louis Armstrong playing with Erskine Tate at the Vendome Theatre with that trumpet with the spotlight on him - I quickly gave up the trumpet.
